how_bia_works_in_plain_words: How bia works, in plain words
a_normal_computer_starts_up_into: A normal computer starts up into a desktop full of programs. A computer running bia starts up into one long, friendly conversation — with you, your family, your customers, and the computer itself.
from_a_usb_stick_to_a: From a USB stick to a living helper
everything_reaches_bia_the_same_way: Everything reaches bia the same way: as a message with a sender and a place. Your typing on the screen, a WhatsApp from a customer, a phone call, a reminder that is due, a job that just finished. That is why bia never mixes people up, and why it can juggle many things at once without losing track.
a_usb_stick_of_8_gb: A USB stick of 8 GB or more (bigger if you want the brain on the stick).
a_computer_almost_any_pc_or: A computer: almost any PC or laptop from the last ten or so years, or a small ARM mini-PC.
for_messengers_any_of_a_telegram: For messengers: any of a Telegram account, a phone with WhatsApp to link to, a Facebook account (for Messenger) or an Instagram account.
for_the_cloud_brain_an_internet: For the cloud brain: an internet connection and an account with an AI provider. DeepSeek V4.1 is the cheapest good choice today.
optional_for_the_brain_on_the: Optional, for the brain on the stick (no internet needed): a high-end graphics card, or unified memory, with at least 64 GB of video memory (VRAM).
no_programming_you_talk_to_bia: No programming. You talk to bia in your own words.
no_monitor_once_it_runs_use: No monitor once it runs — use its private app from your phone.
no_subscription_to_bia_itself_it: No subscription to bia itself. It is free software.
no_cloud_account_keeps_your_agents: No cloud account keeps your agent’s data. It stays on bia’s disk.
write_bia_onto_a_usb_stick: Write bia onto a USB stick
download_the_small_bia_deploy_app: Download the small bia deploy app for Mac, Windows or Linux. Choose how bia should think — usually a cloud brain, or a brain on the stick for powerful computers — and write the stick. Renting a server instead? The same app puts bia there, no stick needed.
start_a_computer_from_the_stick: Start a computer from the stick
plug_it_into_a_pc_or: Plug it into a PC or laptop and switch on. The screen shows bia instead of Windows or a desktop. Nothing on the computer’s own disk is touched unless you ask.
type_on_the_screen_or_open: Type on the screen, or open bia’s private app from your phone — bia shows you how to get a personal certificate for it.
ask_bia_to_join_whatsapp_telegram: Ask bia to join WhatsApp, Telegram, Messenger or Instagram, give it a name and a photo, introduce it to the people it will help.
move_bia_from_the_stick_onto: Move bia from the stick onto the computer’s own disk when you are ready, so the stick is free again. From then on it updates and repairs itself, and moves to a new computer when you get one.
which_disks_are_in_this_computer: Which disks are in this computer?
is_there_parking_at_the_guesthouse: Is there parking at the guesthouse?
a_reminder_is_due_call_the: A reminder is due: “Call the plumber”.
a_background_job_finished_photos: A background job finished: photos sorted.
answers_maria_on_whatsapp_tells_you: Answers Maria on WhatsApp, tells you about the disks on the screen, reminds you about the plumber, and reports the photos are done.
a_connection_to_an_ai_language: A connection to an AI language model in the cloud — or, on a powerful computer, one that runs on bia’s own machine.
messengers_calls_speech_in_about_a: Messengers, calls, speech in about a hundred languages, and its own chat app.
bia_is_a_complete_modern_operating: bia is a complete, modern operating system, and it controls all of it itself: programs, a web browser, the screen, files.
a_vault_for_passwords_two_factor: A vault for passwords, two-factor codes and passkeys, kept on its own disk.
a_diary_reflections_an_address_book: A diary, reflections, an address book and a calendar that survive restarts and moves.
tools_to_back_itself_up_move: Tools to back itself up, move to other computers, update and repair itself.

how_bia_turns_a_usb_stick: How bia turns a USB stick and an ordinary computer into a helpful mind: one conversation for everything, a cloud brain, and nothing to program.
